Ernest Hemingway (1899-1961) was an American author and journalist. His writing style, characterized by simplicity and understatement, influenced modern fiction, as [[11]] his life of adventure.
Hemingway started his career as a journalist at 17. In the 1920s, he was sent to Europe as a newspaper correspondent to [[12]] such events as the Greek Revolution. During this period, he produced his early important works, including The Sun Also Rises. Among his later works, the most outstanding is The Old Man and the Sea (1952), which became perhaps his most famous book, finally winning him the Pulitzer Prize he had long been [[13]].
Hemingway liked to portray soldiers, hunters, bullfighters—tough, at times primitive people whose courage and honesty are set against the brutal ways of modern society, and who in this [[14]] lose hope and faith. His straightforward prose is particularly effective in his short stories, some of [[15]] are collected in Men Without Women (1927). In 1954, Hemingway was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature. He died in Idaho in 1961.

groups.passage:
Road running is one of the most popular and accessible athletic activities in the world. It refers to the sport of running on paved roads or established paths as opposed to track and field, or cross country running. The three most common [[16]] for road running events are 10K runs, half marathons (21.1K), and marathons (42.2K).
Road running is unique among athletic events because it [[17]] all ages and abilities. In many cases first time amateurs are welcome to participate in the same event as running club members and even current world-class [[18]]. Sometimes it may also include wheelchair entrants.
Road running often offers those [[19]] a range of challenges such as dealing with hills, sharp bends, rough weather, and so on. Runners are advised to train prior to participating in a race. Another important factor contributing to success is a suitable pair of running shoes.
Road running is often a community-wide event that highlights or raises money for an issue or project. [[20]], Race for the Cure is held throughout the U.S. to raise breast cancer awareness. This race is also run in Germany, Italy, and Puerto Rico.

groups.passage:
Since the early 1990s, the lithium-ion battery has been the most suitable battery for portable electronic equipment. Today, they’re commonly used for cellphones, computers, tablets, digital cameras, and other devices.
Lithium-ion batteries have nearly twice the energy density of traditional nickel cadmium batteries. [[31]] This feature has important implications for cellphones and computers, because it makes these items more portable for consumers. It also makes power tools easier to use and allows workers to use them for longer periods of time.
[[32]] Lithium-ion batteries retain no “memory” of their power capacity from previous charging cycles. Thus they require no scheduled cycling and can be fully re-fueled to their maximum capacity during each charging cycle. Other rechargeable battery types, in contrast, retain information from previous charging cycles, which wastes valuable storage space. Over time, this makes these rechargeable batteries hold less of a charge.
[[33]] It is fragile and requires a protection circuit to maintain safe operation. A high load could overheat the pack and safety might be jeopardized. [[34]] After 2-3 years of use, the pack often becomes unserviceable due to a large voltage drop caused by high internal resistance.
It should be noted, however, that manufacturers are constantly making improvements on lithium-ion batteries. [[35]] With such rapid progress, the use of lithium-ion batteries will certainly expand further.

options_bank.B: Despite its overall advantages, the lithium-ion battery has its drawbacks.

options_bank.D: Attempts to develop rechargeable lithium-ion batteries failed due to memory problems.

groups.passage: Fabergé eggs are jeweled eggs that were made by the famous Russian jeweler, the House of Fabergé, from 1885 to 1917. The eggs were made of valuable metals or stones coated with beautiful colors and decorated with precious jewels. The first Fabergé egg was crafted for Tsar Alexander III, who gave his wife, the Empress Maria Fedorovna, an Easter egg to celebrate their 20th wedding anniversary. He placed an order with a young jeweler, Peter Carl Fabergé, whose beautiful creations had caught Maria’s eye earlier. On Easter morning of 1885, what appeared to be a simple enameled egg was delivered to the palace. But to the delight of the Empress, the egg opened to a golden yolk; within the yolk was a golden hen; and concealed within the hen was a diamond miniature of the royal crown and a tiny ruby egg. Unfortunately, the last two surprises are now lost to history. Empress Maria was so delighted by this gift that Alexander appointed Fabergé a “goldsmith by special appointment to the Imperial Crown.” The Tsar also asked Fabergé to make an Easter egg every year. The requirements were straightforward: Each egg must be unique, and each must contain a pleasant surprise. With excellent craftsmanship and an inventive spirit, Peter Fabergé and his successors repeatedly met the challenge. The House of Fabergé made approximately 50 Imperial Easter Eggs for Tsar Alexander III and his son Nicholas II until 1917, when the Russian revolution broke out. Today, the term “Fabergé eggs” has become a synonym of luxury and the eggs are regarded as masterpieces of the jeweler’s art. More significantly, perhaps, they serve as reminders of the last Russian imperial family.

groups.passage:
Six Sigma is a highly disciplined process that helps companies focus on developing and delivering near-perfect products and services. The word “sigma” is a statistical term that measures how far a given process falls short of perfection. The central idea behind Six Sigma is that if a company can measure how many “defects” they have in a commercial production process, they can systematically figure out how to eliminate the problems and get as close to “zero defects” as possible.
Training and teamwork are essential elements of the Six Sigma methodology. In other words, companies need to have their team leaders and team members trained to implement the Six Sigma processes. They must learn to use the measurement and improvement tools. They also need to learn communication skills necessary for them to involve customers and suppliers and to serve their needs.
Six Sigma was developed in 1986 by Motorola, an American telecommunications company. Engineers in Motorola used it as an informal name for a plan to reduce faults in production processes. A few years later, Motorola extended the name “Six Sigma” to mean a general performance improvement method, beyond purely “defect reduction” in the production process. In 1995, Jack Welch, CEO of General Electrics (GE), decided to implement Six Sigma in GE; and by 1998 GE claimed that Six Sigma had generated over three-quarters of a billion dollars of cost savings.
By 2000, Six Sigma was effectively established as an industry in its own right, involving the training, consultancy and implementation of Six Sigma methodology in all sorts of organizations around the world. Organizations as diverse as local governments, prisons, hospitals, the armed forces, banks, and multi-national corporations have been adopting Six Sigma for quality and process improvement.

groups.passage: Imagine two bottlenose dolphins swimming in the Gulf of Mexico. You hear a series of clicks, whistles, and whines coming from each, much like a conversation. We can’t be sure what they are discussing, but scientists do believe dolphins call each other by “name.” A recent study suggests the marine mammals not only produce their own unique “signature whistles,” but they also recognize and mimic whistles of other dolphins they are close to and want to see again. It seems that dolphins can call those they know by mimicking their distinct whistles. “They’re abstract names,” said Randall Wells, one of the authors of the study. To conduct the study, the researchers listened to recordings of about 250 wild bottlenose dolphins made around Florida’s Sarasota Bay from 1984 to 2009, and four captive dolphins at a nearby aquarium. Some wild dolphins were briefly captured and held in separate nets by the research team, allowing them to hear but not see each other. Researchers found that dolphins familiar with each other would mimic the whistle of another in that group when they were separated. Most of this took place among mothers and calves, or among males who were close associates, suggesting it was affiliative and not aggressive—somewhat like calling out the name of a missing child or friend. Whistle copying of this sort was not found in dolphins that happened to cross paths in the wild. This use of vocal copying is similar to its use in human language, where the maintenance of social bonds appears to be more important than the immediate defense of resources. This helps differentiate dolphins’ vocal learning from that of birds, which tend to address one another in a more “aggressive context.” If confirmed, this would be a level of communication rarely found in nature. If dolphins can identify themselves and address friends with just a few squeaks, it’s easy to imagine what else they’re saying. However, as the authors of the study point out, all we can do right now is still imagine.

groups.passage:
With soaring rock formations, uniquely-rippled landscapes, and mysterious underground cities, the Goreme National Park is an incredible tourist attraction in central Turkey.
Thousands of years ago a group of ancient volcanoes spewed out layer upon layer of thick ash and lava which formed the Cappadocia region, where the Goreme National Park is now located. Over the centuries the wind and rain worked their magic on this land, carving out spectacular gorges and leaving behind the dramatic towering formations of rock pillars that reach heights of 40 meters. These amazing structures are usually called “fairy chimneys.” They come in an extraordinary range of shapes and sizes, but most are tall and resemble king trumpet mushrooms with a cap on top. The top stone is the hardest part of each formation and protects the softer rock underneath from erosion. Eventually, however, these caps fall off, whereupon the wind and rain start to cut away the cone until it, too, collapses. The unique landforms of the Goreme valley have created its lunar-like landscape, also known as a moonscape.
But the Goreme National Park has always been much more than its dramatic scenery. Humans, too, have left their unique mark on the region. The Byzantine Christians inhabited the area in the fourth century. They carved thousands of cave churches, chapels, and monasteries out of rock. Many of these churches were decorated with beautiful wall paintings whose colors still retain all their original freshness. The Byzantine Christians even carved out entire underground villages in an effort to hide from the Romans and later, the Muslims. To this day, many of these villages are still inhabited and many of the rock-cut storerooms are still stuffed with grapes, lemons, potatoes and flat bread waiting for the winter.

options.B: It is the outcome of cumulative ash and lava from volcanoes.
options.C: It is the creation of some mysterious forces from the moon.
options.D: It is the result of rock cutting by the Byzantine Christians.

options.D: They have strong bottoms to support their 40-meter height.

options.B: Goreme is a representation of ancient Turkish life.
options.C: Goreme is a living example of the power of nature.
options.D: Goreme is an attraction that mixes the new and the old.

questions.label: 英文作文
questions.stem: 指導別人學習讓他學會一件事物，或是得到別人的指導而自己學會一件事物，都是很好的經驗。請根據你過去幫助別人學習，或得到別人的指導而學會某件事的經驗，寫一篇至少120個單詞的英文作文。文分兩段，第一段說明該次經驗的緣由、內容和過程，第二段說明你對該次經驗的感想。
questions.scoring_notes:
「英文作文」的評分標準是依據內容、組織、文法句構、字彙拼字、體例五個項目給分，字數明顯不足或未依提示分二段的作文則扣總分 1 分。
今年的英文作文要考生描述學會一件事或教別人學會一件事的經驗，第一段說明經驗的緣由內容及過程，第二段說明對這個經驗的感想。很多考生描述教別人或學習不同技能（如游泳、騎單車、學習樂器）或教別人學會一門學科（如數學、英文、中文）的經驗，也有考生描述從別人身上領悟到的經驗及感想，大部分考生都能依題意發揮，內容生動且真實，但也有少數考生未能掌握題意，語言表達不夠自然，無法獲得高分。評分重點為內容是否切題、是否提到這個學習經驗的緣由及所引發的感想、二段文句之間是否有關聯性、是否有足夠事例支持、組織是否連貫合理、句構語法及用字是否適切、以及拼字與標點符號是否正確得當。由評閱抽樣卷可看出，考生對於今年的作文題目大致都能有所發揮，應不難得到理想成績。

extraction.method: python-docx 讀 Word 版題本 paper-2.docx 為主，pdftotext -layout 擷取 paper-1.pdf 逐詞比對，並用 Read 逐頁看 PDF 頁面影像（第 1–8 頁）核對版面、段落、粗斜體與有無插圖；答案 pdftotext answer.pdf＋頁面影像核對；評分原則 pdftotext scoring.pdf＋頁面影像（2 頁）核對；統計以 xlrd 讀 stats-1.xls（英：P/Ph/Pl/D）、stats-2.xls（英：T/H/L 選項分析）、stats-3.xls（工作表 2：英文科非選擇題分數人數統計）；建檔腳本放 scratchpad，未進 repo；查證者另以 python-docx 自行擷取、pdftotext 逐詞 diff、Read 看題本第2–8頁、答案與評分原則頁面影像、xlrd 全量比對三個統計表
issues: 結構與 gsat-spec.json legacy_ast「98–110」期別一致：詞彙 1–10（各1分，題本標為「詞彙」而非「詞彙題」，與 spec 註記相符）、綜合測驗 11–20（2篇×5題）、文意選填 21–30（12個選項 A–L）、篇章結構 31–35（6個選項 A–F，各2分）、閱讀測驗 36–51（4篇×4題，各2分）、中譯英 2題各4分、英文作文 20分（至少120個單詞，文分兩段）；選擇題 72分＋非選擇題 28分＝100分；考試時間 80分鐘（封面）；不倒扣。評分原則的作文評分標準為內容、組織、文法句構、字彙拼字、體例「五個項目」，與 spec changes「105：英文作文評分由五項（含體例）改為四項」相符（104 仍為五項）。
非選擇題題號：題本中譯英子題編為 1、2，英文作文不編號；因 schema 要求 no 為整數，中譯英填 no=1、2（label「中譯英1」「中譯英2」），作文填 no=1（label「英文作文」），因此 validator 出現「題號重複 [1, 2]」warning，label 皆不重複，屬合理（同 ast-105、ast-107、ast-110 慣例）。

中譯英：評分原則（scoring.pdf）沒有公布完整參考譯文，只舉例部分片語的正確譯法與常見錯誤（第1題「平均每兩千人就有一家」譯 with one store for every 2000 people on average 或 on average there is one store for every 2000 people、「便利商店」應為 convenience stores；第2題「生活必需品」daily necessities、「在這些商店繳費」pay bills／pay fees at these stores、「網路訂購之商品」goods ordered online），不是整句答案，故兩題 answer 與 accepted_answers 均為 null，相關文字逐字放在 scoring_notes。兩題 scoring_notes 開頭都放「評分標準與歷年相同…相同的錯誤只扣一次。」與「今年的中譯英為關於臺灣便利商店…應能得到理想的分數。」兩段共通文字；原文「例如：…」是一個長句，依原文「第二句」切開，各自另起一行接在共通文字之後：第1題收「例如：…很多考生誤譯為 convenient stores，」（句末逗號照原文保留），第2題收「第二句「生活必需品」…用法不正確。」（第2題的共通文字與「第二句…」在原文中不相連，中間隔著第1題那一段）。評分原則寫「網路訂購之商品」，題本第2題原文為「網路訂購之物品」，兩者照各自原文保留。
英文作文 answer 為 null；scoring_notes 收錄評分原則中作文評分標準一句（五項給分、字數明顯不足或未依提示分二段扣總分 1 分）與作文說明一段（全文逐字）；評分原則開頭兩段閱卷流程說明（評分標準訂定會議、試閱會議、兩位委員評分取平均等）屬中譯英與作文共通程序，未收錄。

評分原則 PDF 文字層無 CJK 相容表意文字；scoring_notes 照 pdftotext 文字層，中文與英文／數字之間的空白依文字層保留（如「每小題總分 4 分」「扣 0.5 分」「扣總分 1 分」；頁面影像中「扣0.5分」看起來間距較窄，文字層仍有空白），PDF 換行處直接接回（中文與英文在換行處相接時補一個空白，如「necessary living things」「pay fines」），去除頁碼；原文「convenience stores 很多考生誤譯為」中間沒有逗號，照原文。

非選擇題統計：stats-3.xls 工作表「2」只提供「第一題（中譯英兩小題合計，滿分8分）」與「第二題（英文作文，滿分20分）」的分數人數分布，無逐子題資料，也沒有答對率／鑑別度；因此放在 s6、s7 section 層級的 stats（schema 未定義的延伸欄位：source、max_score、registered、absent、examinees、percent_base、score_distribution，同 ast-105、ast-107），題目層級 stats 為 null。原表百分比以報名總人數 57,114（含缺考 2,591；到考 54,523）為分母，已換成 0–1 小數（保留 4 位）；分數區間標籤去除空白（如「9.00- 9.99」→「9.00-9.99」），只收錄有數值的列（第一題最高區間為 8.00-8.99，第二題為 20.00-20.99）。

選擇題 stats：correct_rate／high_group／low_group／discrimination 取自 stats-1.xls「英」的 P、Ph、Pl、D；另加延伸欄位 omit_rate（未答比例）、option_rates_high／option_rates_low（高分組／低分組各選項選答比例），與 option_rates 同取自 stats-2.xls 的 T/H/L 列。已逐題核對 stats-2 標 * 的選項＝answer.pdf 官方答案（51題全部一致）。兩表有 3 處相差 1 個百分點（四捨五入差異），各依原表照錄未調整：第23題 P＝45（stats-1）但 T 列正答 L＝46%（stats-2）；第27題 Pl＝21 但 L 列正答 H＝22%；第34題 Pl＝16 但 L 列正答 F＝17%。原表為整數百分比，option_rates 加總因四捨五入與未答（0–1%）略偏離 1。
頂層 parts 為延伸欄位（同 ast-105、ast-107、ast-110），保存「第壹部分：選擇題（占72分）」「第貳部分：非選擇題（占28分）」標題與第貳部分的說明文字（逐字）；封面「作答注意事項」未收錄。
已逐頁看 PDF 頁面影像（第 1–8 頁）：本卷沒有任何插圖、圖表或表格，所有題組 figures 為空陣列。

題本中的粗體依規定不保留格式（皆非底線，故未加 ；v1.1 已依 Word 檔粗體 run 在第38、46題被問的選文位置加 … 並填 refers_to）：第38題題幹引號內 “Peter Fabergé and his successors repeatedly met the challenge” 與選文第三段同一句粗體；第46題題幹的 this 與選文第三段 “Most of this took place among mothers and calves…” 中的 this 粗體——注意第三段另有 “Whistle copying of this sort” 也有 this，第46題問的是粗體那一個（顯示給學生時建議另行標示）；第50題 NOT 粗體。斜體（The Sun Also Rises、The Old Man and the Sea、Men Without Women）不保留。PDF 第3頁第30題空格後的 “to control” 以不同字型（較大的無襯線體）印出，屬排版瑕疵，不影響內容。

Word 檔處理：選文空格（底線＋前後空白＋題號）改寫為 [[題號]]，空格後緊接標點者去掉中間空白（如 “been [[13]].”、“world-class [[18]].”、“[[20]], Race for the Cure”）；Word 第48段（“20 , Race for the Cure…”）與第125段（“Some wild dolphins were briefly captured…”）沒有首行縮排，PDF 頁面影像確認分別是第16–20題選文第四段、第44–47題選文第三段的延續（前者是空格被移到下一行，後者是跨頁），已以一個空白接回同一段；第31–35題選項 (A)–(F) 與中譯英子題號 1、2 是 Word 自動編號（無文字），依 PDF 補上／對應；Tab 與行尾多餘空白已去除。

與 pdftotext -layout 文字逐詞比對，選擇題部分英文（選文、題幹、選項、選項庫，共 3,086 個以空白分隔的詞，空格 [[題號]] 計入）除下列 PDF 擷取瑕疵外完全一致：pdftotext 的 “re -fueled”、“origi nal” 是兩端對齊造成的字距（頁面影像與 Word 皆為 re-fueled、original），“multi-／national” 是行尾斷字（Word 為 multi-national），均照 Word。

說明文字照 Word 檔原字元保留：詞彙、綜合測驗、閱讀測驗、英文作文的「說明︰」用 U+FE30 冒號，文意選填、篇章結構、中譯英與第貳部分用全形「：」；中譯英與英文作文說明第2點在 Word 檔前面有三個全形空白（U+3000）作縮排對齊，已去除並以換行分隔。英文作文 stem 去掉開頭的「提示：」標籤（同 ast-105、ast-107、ast-110）；Word 檔寫「至少120個單詞」，PDF 排版顯示為「至少 120」（自動中英間距），照 Word 檔。

選文與題幹原文照錄、未更正：第40–43題選文 “General Electrics (GE)”（公司正式名稱為 General Electric；第43題選項 A 的 General Motors 是干擾項，選文未提及）；第3題題幹 “very much technical and specialized”（very much 修飾形容詞的用法罕見）；第16–20題選文 “first time amateurs”、“cross country running” 未加連字號；第48–51題選文 Goreme 未加變音符號（Göreme）。

標註（tags）為解析者判讀：第11題 as did his life of adventure 為 as 引導的倒裝句（did 代替 influenced），標 grammar／inversion；第15題 some of which 標 relative_clause；第19題 those involved 為過去分詞後位修飾，標 grammar／participle、answer_pos verb（同 ast-106 慣例）；第17題 caters to、第23題 sweep through 為片語動詞，標 phrase／phrase；第20題 For example 標 connective；第10題 entitled 標 word_meaning 並註 be entitled to V；第25、30題 wider、harder 雖為比較級，但同組兩個比較級需依語意區分，標 word_meaning。篇章結構 clue：31 transition_word（E 句 That is 換句話說，承接 energy density，下句 This feature 指 E 句內容）、32 topic_sentence（A 句 also a low maintenance battery 為「無記憶效應」段的主題句）、33 topic_sentence（B 句 Despite its overall advantages…drawbacks 轉入缺點段）、34 lexical_cohesion（F 句 Another downside／internal resistance ↔ 下句 high internal resistance）、35 lexical_cohesion（C 句 every six months or so ↔ 下句 such rapid progress）；D 為干擾句。閱讀：38 問粗體句的意思標 vocab_in_context，42 標 structure（末兩段依時間順序），46 reference，47 inference，44、51 main_idea，50「NOT been a function」依本 repo 慣例標 not_mentioned，其餘 detail。英文作文 essay_type 標 topic（同 ast-105–107、109、110；指導別人或受人指導學會一件事的經驗，文分兩段）。SDGs：s2g2 [3]（路跑與 Race for the Cure 乳癌防治宣導）、s3g1 [3]（傳染病）、s5g3 [14]（海洋哺乳類）、s5g4 [11]（11.4 保護文化與自然遺產）、s7g1 [4]（學習與教學）；其餘無明確關聯，填空陣列。

查證者（verifier）獨立核對結果：51題答案逐題對照 answer.pdf 文字層與頁面影像全部一致；選文、題幹、選項、選項庫逐字對照 Word 檔（python-docx 自行擷取，空格位置轉 [[題號]] 後整串比對）完全一致，再與 pdftotext -layout 逐詞比對，只有 re -fueled／origi nal／行尾 multi-／aggressive— 等擷取瑕疵；8 篇選文段落數（3/4/2/5/4/4/5/3）依頁面影像縮排確認，第16–20題第四段與第44–47題第三段的接回正確（第46題問「第三段」的 this，“Most of this took place” 必須在第三段內，可佐證）；第1–8頁頁面影像確認無圖表；選擇題 51 題 P/Ph/Pl/D 與 T/H/L 各選項比例（含未答）全部對照 stats-1、stats-2 原表一致，非選擇題分數分布對照 stats-3 工作表「2」一致；中譯英、作文題目與說明對照 Word 與 PDF 一致，scoring_notes 各段在評分原則文字層中逐字可找到。修正：本條以外只修正 issues 中兩處敘述（未答比例實際為 0–1%；英文詞數改為可重現的計數方式），題目資料本身未發現錯誤。
